messages.subject: Refund for Order L-41586
messages.text:
Order L-41586 
 
 
 I just received my order for a bag/tote. I wrote a review on Shop and got a snarky response. The responder did not put their name. I said I didn't like the product now that I have it. There's no pockets on the inside and the straps are too short for me. The responder said the pics show no pockets and "did we say it had pockets?". "The straps are adjustable, did you try adjusting them?" I cannot see the picture well enough to see there aren't any pockets. I assumed all such bags have pockets, my mistake. As for the straps, the one I received has a strap on each side, sewn on. They do not adjust. Maybe I got a faulty one...I would like a refund. How do I go about it?

Hello Joni

I apologize for the inconvenience caused. We understand your concern and have no problem processing your refund request.

As for the response, maybe there is some confusion, because this product is supposed to come with a removable shoulder strap (distinct from the handles you are referring to). Did you receive it?

Either way, please rest assure that since you asked for a return within the return window, we will grant it without any problem.
No, mine did not come with a removeable shoulder strap. What do I need to do to start the process?
Hello? Will someone please tell me how to proceed with shipping my item back to get a refund?

 Joni Baker

messages.subject: Re: Please Respond
messages.text:
Hello Joni,
 

 We are very sorry for the delay in responding to you. 
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return followed by a refund:
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to get a return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the returned products, and attach the label to the package.
 

 3. Take everything to the nearest Canada Post office.
 

 4. Once the return package is in transit, we will proceed with the refund of your order, minus a handling fee of $9.99.
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
